title: Sạp cửa hàng Garden + Cloud, vòi tưới cấp 2–5
decisions: Decision 029: each Area has a shop stall in its scene (bld_shop_garden on the Garden lawn, bld_shop_cloud on the Cloud island) and the sprinkler looks bigger at each level (bld_sprinkler_l2..l5, same design growing). Until the art arrives the game draws a code stall and scales the base sprinkler. Manifest rows are added when the art is delivered.

sheets.name: S
sheets.title: 2 sạp cửa hàng
sheets.notes: Both are a small cosy market stall seen three-quarter from slightly above: a wooden counter with goods on it, two wooden posts and a scalloped striped cloth awning on top, a little hanging wooden sign with NO writing. A bit wider than tall. Each stands on its own small base patch with a soft contact shadow.

cells.desc: Garden seed shop: green-and-cream striped awning, honey-wood counter with seed packets in a crate, a basket of carrots and corn, a small sack of compost, a watering can at its side; it stands on a small grass patch

Cloud flower shop: lilac-and-white striped awning with a tiny star charm, creamy-white wooden counter with flower seed packets, little glass bottles of sky-blue pure water and a pot of pastel flowers; it stands on a small fluffy white cloud patch

sheets.name: W
sheets.title: Vòi tưới cấp 2–5

hints.what: the level-1 sprinkler (the same design must grow level by level)

sheets.notes: The same garden sprinkler as image 2, upgraded step by step from left to right; keep its blue pipe and wooden post. Each one is a little taller and richer than the one before. No water spray drawn (the game draws the water).

cells.desc: Level 2: a bit taller, a brass band on the pipe and a second small nozzle
Level 3: taller again, a round brass rotating head with three nozzles and a small stone base
Level 4: a sturdy tower sprinkler on a stone base with a small water tank on its side and four nozzles
Level 5: a grand golden-and-blue sprinkler tower with a little roof, a water tank and a ring of nozzles, flowers at its foot
